games.title: 2048 — slide and merge tiles to reach 2048
games.desc: Free 2048: slide tiles, merge equal numbers, reach 2048. Play with arrow keys, WASD or swipe; your best score stays on this device. 2048 在线游戏：滑动合并相同数字，一路合到 2048，键盘和触屏都能玩，最高分只存本机。Game 2048: geser dan gabungkan ubin bernilai sama sampai 2048, bisa keyboard atau usap; skor terbaik hanya di perangkat ini.
games.spec: 4×4 sliding merge puzzle. Arrow/WASD/swipe. Tiles slide to the edge; equal tiles merge once per move; merged value adds to score; each valid move spawns a 2 (90%) or 4 (10%) in a random empty cell. Reach 2048 to win, continue allowed; game over when the board is full with no adjacent equal tiles.
